title: Return Values, Not Printed Output
description: Make evaluate return a value and keep printing in a thin REPL wrapper, so tests check a return value instead of capturing stdout.

steps.description: This splits computation from printing. The page says if the interpreter prints results instead of returning them, testing requires capturing `sys.stdout`, so the better design is to make `evaluate` return a value and keep printing in a thin wrapper used only by the REPL and file-runner.
`evaluate` returns a value and does pure computation, with the comment marking that there is no `print`.
`repl` loops, reads a line, evaluates it, and prints the result. Printing lives here, not in the evaluator.
